source: SPEC-v8-undeniable.md §3 (Scribe): consequence echoes — one-line signs near the NEXT era boundary after an action-marked encounter resolves. One per action-marked encounter (154, ids from research/action-choices-v7.json). Text is choice-generic: it names what remains, not which option was taken, so it reads true for any outcome. ≤70 chars. Naming per SPEC §8.

echoes.text: The claim-stone stands at the new border. Someone polished it.
Salt still changes hands on that road. The terms are yours.
The ash pit is cold. The brand-marks outlived the fire.
The fire rock holds warmth some mornings. People remember why.
The first furrow has filled and plowed since. The marker stays.
The ford has a bridge now. Nobody recalls the stranger's terms.
The seed cache shrine keeps its count. Some hollows stay full.
The ridge is grazed to a decision. The herder's wall holds.
The tin-road cairn has grown by a hundred hands.
The tally wall was copied before it cracked. Both copies stand.
The dreamer's advice is policy now. Nobody remembers the dream.
The first granary feeds a customs house now. Doors both ways.
The canal splits three fields. All three wave thanks, or blame.
The first debt tablet is in a temple case. Interest wasn't.
Two calendars hang in the yard. The dispute stone arbitrates.
The swarm passed. What was done at the verge is remembered.
The yard wall leans east now. It has never once been argued down.
The yoke test field has oxen granddaughters of that first pair.
The water treaty stone is worn smooth. Upstream disputes anyway.
The census house counts twice what the granary holds.
The temple still isn't finished. The tithe certainly is.
That chosen seed line is the whole valley's crop now.
The tin route runs on your delegation's terms. Mostly.
The assay bench is busy today. Somebody always tests the metal.
The law-stele stands in the market. Half of it gets quoted.
Mile markers from that camp count all the way to the frontier.
The palace archive sealed your season. The seal holds.
The philosopher's invoice was paid, disputed, or both.
The quarantine line is a road now. The memory is a fence.
Copies made in that room are older than the library.
The general's popularity became a statue. Statues get opinions.
The third recoinage held. Ask the mint how many tries it cost.
The scriptorium slate still shows last winter's budget.
What decay took, this hall kept. What it kept, check carefully.
The hill chief's protection has a successor. And a tariff.
The relic stall moved twice. Authenticity pending, as ever.
The longship haul-out is a slipway now. The winter camp is a name.
The heresy file grew a shelf. The question stayed polite.
The parish stone divides two harvests. Neither side fasts the same.
The lost imperial road resurfaces after rain. Still straight.
The rededicated well still answers to its old name, quietly.
The wandering scholar cited you. Twice, in different centuries.
The ash harvest was counted, mourned, replanted. Order varies.
The cathedral's unfinished aisle finally got a roof. Debate continues.
The weavers' guildmaster seats someone new. The loom doesn't care.
The relic casket gained a plaque. Authenticity: improved.
The fair court toll book has your entry framed. Or erased.
The charter cross hosts three markets where there was one.
The windmill on the wold turns or doesn't. The lease survives.
The drowned field chapel rings on very high feasts.
The coffeehouse share board priced your voyage. It still moves.
The privateer's tavern table is a counting house now.
The plague ship at anchor became timber, quarantine, or legend.
The longitude clock ticks in the admiralty. The claim is filed.
The chart-rock is marked on every map now. Salvage contested.
The blockade notice expired. The routes it made didn't.
The wreckers' salvage became a warehouse. Then a fortune.
The pirate articles hang framed somewhere. Signed by the whole crew.
The rival envoy's answer is policy on the far coast.
The petition press run is a museum case with your mark in it.
The declaration hangs curtains-first in the new hall.
The terror clause was repealed, invoked, or both. Check the date.
The coronation office invoiced the republic. Terms: historical.
The smuggler's blockade route is a postal lane now. Roughly.
The rights pamphlet stall sold out. The idea didn't.
The war bond window closed. The coupon outlived the regime.
The crated archive was liberated, hidden, or borrowed. Unpack it.
The conscription roll lists you under both spellings.
The émigré silver is auction plate now. Hallmarks intact.
The rival's factor has a storefront. Signage: neutral.
Press No. 1 ran ten thousand more like your page.
The apprentice sets type faster than the master. Ask who taught them.
The cartographer's sign marks a real shop now. Coastline updated.
The company factor's ledger has a column titled you.
The unsold chintz became rags, paper, or a fashion. All three.
The lens from that bench sees further. And clearer about you.
Lloyd's bench rates your risk. The premium reflects it.
Lock-gate cut three opens on schedule. Mostly on time.
The beam engine pumps for a town that forgot its name.
The timetable board carries your decision in small print.
The navvies' union card is honored at this cut. Check the rate.
The glasshouse footprint hosts a second exhibition.
The cellar dwelling was inspected, condemned, or reprieved.
The tired inspector filed your answer. The next one reads it.
The patentee's exhibit has a competitor now. Same week.
The refrigerated hold landed its first cargo. The second follows.
The conversion order ran by Friday. The lines hum differently now.
The ration counter issued your call. Queues remember.
The codebreaking hut is silent. The habit of reading signals isn't.
The home front shift line runs twenty-four hours. Yours included.
The bombing display board was taken down. The map stays drawn.
The parcel exchange coordinator routed your answer onward.
The occupation currency crate was opened, burned, or banked.
The rocketry checkpoint let someone through. Watch the sky.
The ceasefire telegram arrived. Three seconds matters less now.
The victory parade inventory listed you. Confirmed or not.
The spy's report reached the rival conglomerate. Filed under you.
Assembly bay seven turns out your decision, unit by unit.
The Corinthian facade holds. So does whatever leans on it.
The broadcast tower carries your voice on the hour.
The efficiency engineer timed your choice. It beat the standard.
The credit window approved, waitlisted, or forgave. See file.
The early-warning array watches what you decided to watch.
The tracking board beeps your answer across the sky.
The funding rush cleared. The gap it aimed at is smaller.
The test pilot signed. The waiver cites your decision.
The satellite panel resolved you clearly. Everyone saw.
The spin-off catalogue sold your era back to itself.
The scrub notice came down. The next window is yours.
The relay lease renewed. The signal carries your terms.
The night shift console logs your answer as nominal.
The station proposal has a corner of the drafting table left.
The relic weighed in at launch mass. It came along.
The mainframe row computes payroll with your logic in it.
The clean room fabbed your decade. Yield: acceptable.
The flowchart with your branch on it is standard practice now.
The model train set runs the closed line nightly. Nostalgia gauge.
The ARPANET node forwards your packet. Hops: growing.
The arcade cabinet credits you. Insert coin to continue.
The ground station log records your pass. Signal clear.
The interstate mile marker stands where you chose the grade.
The launch crate is unboxed in a hundred rooms. Yours first.
The phreak demonstrated your system's manners. Politely.
The orbital receiver beams your settlement down, watt by watt.
The consent terminal logged your edit. The form is permanent.
The longevity clinic intake cites your ruling. Waitlist: long.
The carbon ticker prices your decision live. It moves.
Day nine of the hall negotiation ended. The terms are yours.
The duck-curve desk rides your curve. So far, seaworthy.
The chokepoint map wall has your route circled in green.
The reception center registered your answer at the gate.
The Benthics countersigned the term sheet. Fine print: oceanic.
The final diesel bay closed. The depot hums a different note.
The reforestation futures mature in decades. Your planting did.
The heat dome passed. The ops grid still runs your protocol.
The Benthics deferred the entropy. The notes desk kept receipts.
The trending kiosk still crops you. Ninety seconds, latest take.
The outbreak board cleared, or didn't. Your posting stands.
The memetic advisory lifted. The phrase you used persists.
Deepfake season flagged your footage. Verified originals: fewer.
The heist warning posted your precaution. Or your absence.
The feed audit leak named the era. It named you in passing.
The light-lag relay carries your word. ETA: eleven years.
The drift corridor chart pins your correction. Holding.
The engine-priest intones your decision in the hull liturgy.
The memory winter triage console kept what you chose. Cold.
The decade watch logbook has your entry. Legible. Dated.
The last broadcast from home plays on the archive deck.
The Custodian carried it through the hatch. Weight logged.
The Benthics' lead speaker cited your answer. Court adjourned.
The dismantling notice posted. Orbit complies, mostly.
The intercept panel logged pattern, not message. Your era's doing.
The requisition order was granted, queued, or worshipped.
The Feral liaison acknowledged your grid. It bit back gently.
